Ravi (PM): Quick note: we need a ranked partner slate + legal/PO path spelled out before Mondayplanning. Target cohort size: 10 active partners, with a 4W onboarding runway. Priorities: coverage across model types, production telemetry usage, and at least 3 partners with private deployment interest.

Eve (Customer Success): Suggest prioritizing orgs that already have customer-facing ML features. They give us richer signals. Also prefer teams that can commit to weekly bug triage slots.

Bea (Data): For scoring I'll weight: production traffic (35%), integration complexity (25%), evaluation signal value (20%), business strategic fit (20%). We can rank leads into A/B/C buckets.

Kai (Eng): Engineering practicality: A partners must have 2 named eng contacts and CI access for smoke runs. B partners might be product-only but with SRE support. C is exploratory. Also call out any infra risk flags (on-prem, legacy auth).

Tess (Legal): Procurement timelines vary. Quickest path: NDA + pilot SOW + credit agreement. If finance/PO needed, expect 2-4 weeks extra. For private/on-prem we need a separate data/process addendum.

Ravi (PM): Proposed outreach sequence: 1) A-bucket (high priority) outreach this week; 2) B-bucket next week; 3) C-bucket as rolling list. Acceptance target: 50% of A-bucket.

Omar (SRE): Ops gating: must be able to run our smoke suite within 7-21 days depending on partner bucket. For private, require VPN or VPC peering checklist before any sensitive data transfer. Reserve 2 infra slots/week for onboarding.

Eve (Customer Success): Incentives to boost accept rate: $2k credits + co-marketing offer + 1x dedicated onboarding sprint. For strategic, offer extended SLA for pilot window.

Ravi (PM): What about cancellation/refund? I propose: full credit refund if cancelled before any infra work; 50% if after infra reservation; 0% after onboarding begins.

Tess (Legal): Fine but add a clause for forced delays (govt compliance reviews) to allow a one-time reschedule without penalty. Also need to surface IP/data ownership language for eval logs.

Bea (Data): Measurement plan: capture baseline metrics for latency, token cost, and qualitative accuracy (partner scored) pre/post. Use cohort-level dashboards and individual partner time-series. NPS (pilot satisfaction) at 30 days as qualitative metric.

Kai (Eng): Quick screening form suggestion (short):
```
name, org, contact_email, deployment_type(hosted/dedicated/private), expected_peak_qps, avg_input_tokens, security_requirements, preferred_start_date
```
Keep it <8 fields so outreach gets responses.

Ravi (PM): Good. Also need a friction log: each partner has a single-line friction reason if they drop out (legal, infra, timing, product mismatch). We'll use that to iterate on the process.

Omar (SRE): Escalation path: if onboarding blocks exceed 5 business days without progress, escalate to oncall lead + PM. For private installs, include a 3-day SLA for initial connectivity troubleshooting.

Eve (Customer Success): Can we require partners to run the same eval prompt set during pilot? That would make comparisons easier.

Bea (Data): Yes — repository of canonical prompts + scoring script will be provided. We'll run weekly cohort leaderboards and anonymize public summaries.

Tess (Legal): Action for legal: I'll prepare a pilot SOW template + quick NDA + private-deploy addendum. Expect a first draft in 48 hours.

Kai (Eng): I'll prepare the smoke-run checklist + onboarding runbook. Put a sample CLI in the repo.

Ravi (PM): Action items (owner -> due):
- Bea: produce ranking weights + initial A/B/C list (due Fri EOD)
- Tess: SOW/NDA/private addendum draft (48h)
- Kai: smoke checklist + sample scripts (Tue)
- Omar: infra reservation cadence + connectivity checklist (Tue)
- Eve: outreach copy + incentive package details (Thu)

recruit-bot: Reminder: outreach campaign draft scheduled for Fri 09:00.

Ravi (PM): Thanks all. Final ask: keep screening tight. If a lead can't answer the short form in 7 days, move to C-bucket. We'll reconvene Mon morning to finalize the first outreach wave.
